doc: One link rewritten 200,000 times (200,000 versions of note:1 -k0-> note:2, each live for one tx) beside a few other links, seeded into a running hub's schema-7 store: graph/neighbors as of a tx in the middle of the churn, one hop and two, against the same hop now, 20 samples each (--perf records every sample, no budget; the design's reference is 17.9 ms for one hop before links were immutable).

sql: insert into entity (n, id, kind, origin, ver, created_tx, updated_tx) with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i + 1 from c where i < 20) select i, 'note:' || i, 'note', 'recorded', 1, 1, 1 from c
insert into link (src, kind, dst, origin, tx_from, tx_to) with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i + 1 from c where i < 200000) select 1, 'k0', 2, 'recorded', i, i + 1 from c
insert into link (src, kind, dst, origin, tx_from) with recursive c(i) as (select 2 union all select i + 1 from c where i < 19) select i, 'k0', i + 1, 'recorded', 1 from c
